I found 9 usable items from the last 14 days (14 to 28 Oct 2026). Only one has a company link I could confirm (Amazon), and it may be the general program page rather than the 19 Oct announcement. The rest come from news coverage, so check each one on the company's own site before it goes into a reel. Where an item is old or not open in India, I say so.

**Ways to earn now (India)**

1. **Myntra's affiliate program is now fully open on Instagram in India (15 Oct).** Creators can tag Myntra products in posts and Reels and earn a commission on sales. One report gives 8% to 12%, but that isn't from Myntra, so check it before quoting it. Myntra reports more than 1 million sign-ups in the first month. Who earns: students and homemakers who post outfit or style Reels. Fits PRODUCT or SKILL, and a "Nobody tells you" hook. The catch: you only earn when someone buys, and you'd be competing with 200,000 active creators. [fonearena](https://www.fonearena.com/blog/495062/myntra-instagram-affiliate-programme-1-million-sign-ups.html/amp), [devdiscourse](https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/business/3993002-myntras-instagram-affiliate-program-hits-1mn-sign-ups-unlocks-creator-led-commerce-at-scale)

2. **Amazon India's Influencer Program now lets creators tag products on YouTube and Pinterest (19 Oct).** You earn commission on qualifying purchases on Amazon.in. Amazon says it has about 200,000 creators and that creator earnings rose 60% in a year. That 60% is Amazon's total across all creators, so it can't be used as a figure for one person. Who earns: anyone making product-review Shorts or Pins, with AI scripts and voiceovers. Fits PRODUCT. The catch: commission only, no fixed pay. [aboutamazon.in](https://www.aboutamazon.in/news/retail/amazon-influencer-program-india), [exchange4media](https://www.exchange4media.com/industry-briefing-news/nearly-75-of-amazon-influencers-in-india-from-non-metro-cities-159290.html)

3. **Canva launched Craft, its own AI image model, free in Dream Lab worldwide (22 to 26 Oct).** It makes 2K images in more than 30 sizes and gets the text right in 55 languages, which earlier image tools often got wrong. That makes festive and offer posters for local shops quicker to make and sell. Fits CLIENT. It also gives us the chance to rebuild POSTER under CLIENT if POSTER clears 1.5x on 31 Oct. The catch: making the poster is the easy part, finding shops that will pay is the hard part. [passionateinmarketing](https://www.passionateinmarketing.com/introducing-canva-craft-in-india/), [exhibit.tech](https://www.exhibit.tech/tech-news/canva-craft-launched/)

4. **AI training sites have new India-eligible listings.** OpenTrain posted remote part-time roles on 26 Oct, including Gujarati, Nepali and Punjabi language review and a maths expert role, with pay shown in dollars. Mercor has India listings such as Hindi bilingual writing and Indian tax work. Who earns: bilingual students and graduates with subject knowledge. Fits SITES. The catch: you have to pass their tests, and Outlier has paused sign-ups from some places. Quote pay only exactly as the live listing shows it, because the $15 to $50 an hour figures I found came partly from job aggregators. [opentrain.ai/jobs](https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/), [aitrainer.work/jobs/india](https://aitrainer.work/jobs/india)

5. **GITAM National AI Challenge, ₹20 lakh prize pool, ₹9 lakh for first place, closes 12 Nov.** It's open to class 11 and 12 students across India and entries go through Unstop. It was announced in September but it's still open, and the deadline is coming up. Fits SITES as a news reel. The catch: it's a contest with no guaranteed payout, and I only found one news report, not GITAM's own page. [newsbytes](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/gitam-university-invites-11th-12th-students-to-ai-challenge-2026/tldr)

**Real, but not open in India yet (good for a "coming soon" reel, not for a money promise)**

6. **LinkedIn Advice Sessions (15 Oct):** paid one-to-one video calls you sell from your profile. It's **US only** for now. LinkedIn says more countries will follow but hasn't named them, and it needs Premium. [socialmediatoday](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/linkedin-adds-new-creator-monetization-options/833179/), [netinfluencer](https://www.netinfluencer.com/linkedin-rolls-out-network-feed-creator-dashboard-and-paid-consultations-in-push-toward-side-hustle-economy/)

7. **Spotify podcast Memberships (20 Oct):** creators keep 90% of what fans pay for perks. It's live in 34 markets, but **I couldn't confirm India is one of them.** [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/spotify-launches-paid-podcast-memberships-with-perks-beyond-bonus-content/)

**Heads-up and scam warning**

8. **The free ChatGPT Go year for India ends in early November 2026** for people who signed up from 4 Nov 2025. Anyone who runs a side gig on it should plan for a ₹ cost or a free fallback. Google AI Plus is still free for a year for eligible Indian students, and the deadline to claim it is 31 Dec. I found this on a blog, so check both on OpenAI's and Google's own pages. [medium](https://medium.com/@adi_leviim/which-ai-student-deal-is-actually-free-7a34c539ec78)

9. **Scams: I found no new official Indian advisory in the window.** The pattern being reported is still the WhatsApp or Telegram "task job". It pays a small amount first, then asks for UPI deposits to unlock bigger payouts, and AI now makes the fake recruiter profiles look real. Rule for the reel: a real AI training site tests you and pays you, it never charges you. If money is lost, call 1930 and report it at cybercrime.gov.in. Fits SITES with the #2 backfire hook. [careerindia](https://www.careerindia.com/features/telegram-and-whatsapp-task-scams-how-to-identify-fake-work-from-home-job-offers-and-protect-your-money-2026-011-65711.html), [uniladtech, 20 Oct](https://uniladtech.com/news/ai/red-flags-ai-job-scams-target-jobseekers-468821-20261020)

**Left out:**
- New Claude, GPT-6 and Gemini model launches: I only found them on aggregator sites and there's no way to earn from them directly.
- Instagram's 90-minute "Features" format: US test only, and it doesn't pay creators.
- ElevenLabs' MoU with Karnataka (6 Oct): too early in the window, and nothing beginners can earn from.
- CapCut: still not available in India's app stores.
- I found no new India-specific numbers on freelance demand. The Upwork report (+109% demand for AI skills, video editing +329%) is from February and measures US clients.
